questions.prompt: Which statement best summarises the central message of this lesson?
questions.answer: Rock evidence connects present observations with past processes.
options: Rock evidence connects present observations with past processes.
Similar-looking stones must have identical histories.
Rock layers can never be disturbed after formation.
The location of a rock sample provides no useful evidence.
questions.explanation: Metnin genel sonucu: Rock evidence connects present observations with past processes.

source.en: Reconstructing Earth's history is therefore an exercise in linking partial observations while making the remaining uncertainty explicit.
source.tr: Bu nedenle Dünya'nın tarihini yeniden kurmak, kalan belirsizliği açıkça belirterek kısmi gözlemleri ilişkilendirme çalışmasıdır.

questions.prompt: Which statement is NOT supported by the lesson?
questions.answer: Similar-looking stones must have identical histories.
